 The Hon'Ble Miss Justice Savitri Ratho
 Order

This matter is taken up through Hybrid arrangement (video conferencing/physical mode).
This writ petition has been filed by the petitioner Guru Charan Nayak with a prayer to direct the opposite party no.2, Tahasildar -cum- Land Acquisition Officer, N.H.-215, Keonjhar to release the compensation amount as per the calculation in the Award Register under Annexure-2 with interest within a stipulated period.

Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that since the earlier award amount, which was fixed as per the Award Register under Annexure-2 was reduced in the revised Award Register under Annexure-3, the petitioner Location: HIGH COURT OF ORISSA, CUTTACK Date: 07-Mar-2025 16:55:22 filed Arbitration Case No.______ of 2024 in the Court of Collector -cum- Arbitrator,
N.H.-215 Project, Keonjhar on 22.04.2024.

entities.text:
Court of Collector -cum- Arbitrator,
N.H.-215 Project, Keonjhar
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: However in the verification of the case, the date has been mentioned to be 22.04.2018 and in the typed portion of the verification, the year has been mentioned to be July, 2023 and in the cause title, the year of the Arbitration Case has been scored out from 2023 and corrected as 2024.
There is also no proof that Annexure-4 has been submitted before the Collector -cum- Arbitrator, N.H.-215 Project, Keonjhar.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: When we made a query to the learned counsel for the petitioner as to whether there is any documentary proof that Annexure-4 has been submitted before the concerned authority, it is submitted that the authority has received the application under section 3G(5) of the National Highways Act, 1956 but no number has yet been allotted to the case.

In view of the above discrepancies in the application, let the learned counsel for the State obtain instruction as to such application under Annexure-4 has been filed before the opposite party no.1,
the Collector and District Magistrate, Keonjhar on 22.04.2024.
List this matter in the week commencing from 24.03.2025.
 ( S.K. Sahoo)
 Judge  ( Savitri Ratho)
